settings.q: How will the selection process for the "Hear a Million Dreams" program work?
settings.a: The selection process is based on medical need and financial circumstances. Each child undergoes a professional hearing assessment, and applications are carefully reviewed to prioritize babies who require urgent intervention and whose families cannot afford treatment. This ensures support reaches those who need it most.

settings.q: Is there a fee to apply for the" Hear a Million Dreams" program?
settings.a: No, there is no fee to apply for the “Hear a Million Dreams” program. It’s completely free for families — the only cost is your generous support through donations.

settings.q: Can I choose who receives my donation?
settings.a: Donations are pooled to support babies based on medical need and urgency, ensuring help reaches those who need it most. While you can’t select a specific child, your contribution directly changes a life.

settings.q: Can I donate any amount, and what happens to it?
settings.a: Yes, you can donate any amount. Every contribution goes toward hearing screenings, professional fittings, hearing aids, and follow-up care for babies in need. Even small donations combine to create life-changing impact.

settings.q: How can I be sure my donation gives the right hearing aid?
settings.a: Your donation funds professional hearing tests, and certified audiologists select and fit the exact hearing aid each child needs. This ensures every baby receives the right, personalized device—not a one-size-fits-all solution.

settings.q: Why are we helping babies under 1 year old, in their Golden Period?
settings.a: Because the first year of life is a baby’s Golden Period — when brain development is at its fastest and foundations for health, learning, and emotional growth are formed. Supporting babies during this time creates lifelong impact.
